tonight.headline: Still 41.5 behind — Saturday changed nothing, so Jacobs is the one lever
body: Bad news first: Furia Regia's Thursday backs banked 41.5 and ESPN has you at 38%, 122.7 to 145.0, unchanged overnight. Rashee Rice is out again (NFL.com Week 7 report) and Gordon is still in the RB slot the projection gives to Jacobs.

Saturday's re-check found no change: Golden was limited Wednesday and Thursday with a shoulder but carries no designation; Pickens practised in full and is not among Dallas's designations; Jacobs is undesignated. Start Jacobs over Gordon before 11:00 Sunday (card below), and get the Loveland claim in before Wednesday 01:00.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Furia Regia still play Love, Jefferson (ankle, full Thursday and Friday per Vikings.com), Lamb and their Thursday backs' 41.5. You need Golden against a Lions defence 25th in DVOA (Covers) and Pickens against an Eagles secondary 25th in EPA per pass (SI).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Breece Hall (questionable) is on their bench, not their lineup. Only your own inactives move this — and none is designated.

doFirst.title: Start Josh Jacobs over Ollie Gordon
doFirst.subtitle: Friday's report came back clean — the condition Friday morning's card waited for — so the projection's 0.9 is taken.

case.label: The status
case.body: Jacobs is not on Green Bay's Friday report — the Packers designate only Franklin (out), Melton, Banks, Riley and St-Juste (NFL.com Week 7 report). LaFleur says he is on track to play the Lions if he keeps improving (NBC Sports 23 Oct 15:55Z; NFL.com roundup). ESPN's DAY_TO_DAY tag is stale.

case.label: The call
case.body: Jacobs 12.7, Gordon 11.8 — COIN FLIP by lineup_check.py, so the projection decides and no thesis is written. The projection already prices a first game back after six weeks on the Exempt List; his workload is the open question, not his status.

case.label: The timing
case.body: Gordon kicks off at 11:00; Green Bay's inactives come at 12:55, too late to undo. If any doubt surfaces by Sunday 10:30 — a Saturday downgrade, a 'game-time decision' — leave Gordon in.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jacobs is inactive or plays under 10 snaps, or Gordon outscores him (archive). Recorded as an outcome, not a thesis.

doFirst.title: Claim Colston Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: Kmet is out for the season and Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8. Drop C.J. Stroud — Houston are on bye too.

case.label: The player
case.body: 12 targets on 83% of snaps Thursday (RotoWire usage 22 Oct), and Cole Kmet's knee is season-ending — the Bears placed him on injured reserve (NFL.com Friday roundup 23 Oct). Chicago's other tight end, Sam Roush, played 21%. The role is his for the season.

case.label: Why priority
case.body: Bloodsports sit 5th in an order that never resets. STRATEGY §4 spends it only on a player who starts at once: Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8 and IPADE's flex takes a tight end, so Loveland starts in Week 8 and has a flex route after. Both of Friday morning's conditions are now met — the diagnosis is season-long, and Rice is ruled out (Chiefs.com 23 Oct).

case.label: The drop — changed on Friday
case.body: Not Rice: Reid ruled him out, but he worked on the side all week and could return against Denver in Week 8 (Heavy 23 Oct); ESPN still carries 156 rest-of-season. Stroud was added as Week 7 cover for Daniels; that job ends Sunday, Houston are on bye in Week 8, and a backup quarterback is near-worthless in a 10-team one-QB league. Dak Prescott (16.0) and Kyler Murray are free agents if Daniels's elbow ever needs cover. The claim processes after Stroud's game, so the drop is legal.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Claim made and Loveland draws under 6 targets in two of Weeks 8-10 (archive), or Daniels misses a game in Weeks 8-10 and the free-agent cover scores less than Stroud did that week (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup tool's Jacobs contingency fires too late
whatWentWrong.lead: It checks at Sun 12:55, after Gordon has kicked off at 11:00.

case.label: What happened
case.body: lineup_check.py times the contingency from Jacobs's own kickoff. Its fallback, Gordon, is locked by then — so a 12:55 inactive would leave the RB slot empty.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The decision moves to Friday's report (clean) and a last look at Sunday 10:30: the Jacobs card above. Pickens's Monday problem from Friday morning is gone — full Friday, no Dallas designations.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: ESPN's lock in this league were per-slot rather than per-player — it is not; a started player cannot be benched.

whatWentWrong.title: Friday morning named the wrong drop for Loveland
whatWentWrong.lead: Rice was the drop; Friday's reporting says Rice may be back next week while Stroud's job ends Sunday.

case.label: What changed
case.body: Reid ruled Rice out, but he did side work all week and the outlook points at Denver in Week 8 (Heavy 23 Oct). Stroud was Week 7 bye cover and Houston are on bye in Week 8.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Rice misses Weeks 8-10 too — then dropping him would have cost nothing and Stroud would have been the better hold.

worthALook.name: Michael Mayer
worthALook.lead: Second choice to Loveland for Likely's Week 8 bye — and Bowers practised in full on Friday.

case.label: The player
case.body: 9 targets, 7 for 95 in Week 6 beside Brock Bowers (Spectrum/AP 18 Oct). Bowers went from limited to FULL on Friday with no status (Raiders.com 23 Oct), so Mayer is the second tight end again.

case.label: The cost
case.body: A free agent — no priority.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if the Loveland claim fails on Wednesday; then add him as a free agent for Week 8, dropping Stroud.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Allgeier
doNotChase.lead: Jeremiyah Love is out again — and Bam Knight out-gained Allgeier 80 to 38 last time.

case.label: The case for
case.body: Love OUT for Week 7 (ankle), Arizona resting him until 100% (SI 22 Oct; NFL.com Week 7 report); Allgeier had 56% of snaps and should keep the goal line (SI 22 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 18 carries for 38 yards against Knight's 15 for 80 (SI 22 Oct) — a committee filling a vacancy, and a waiver-free add would still need a roster spot this team does not have to spare before Week 8.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Love placed on IR and Allgeier named the lead back.

doNotChase.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
doNotChase.lead: Egbuka is out — but three receivers split his 43%.

case.label: The case for
case.body: Emeka Egbuka ruled out (concussion/foot); he had been drawing about 43% of Tampa Bay's receiver targets. Baker Mayfield returns from the thumb (NFL.com roundup 23 Oct; RotoWire 23 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: RotoWire splits the vacancy three ways — Ted Hurst, Tez Johnson and Godwin — and Godwin drew 4 and 8 touches in Weeks 5-6 (screen). One week, one-third of a vacancy.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Egbuka's concussion lingers into Week 8 and Godwin leads the room in targets at Carolina.

doNotChase.name: Roschon Johnson
doNotChase.lead: This week's riser has stopped rising — 2 carries on Thursday; D'Andre Swift took the backfield.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Swift played 86% of snaps and handled 26 of 28 running-back opportunities; Johnson 14% of snaps, 2 carries for 13 (RotoWire usage 22 Oct). The ownership jump was bought on Monangai's injury, and Swift, not Johnson, inherited it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Swift hurt and Monangai (turf toe, uncertain for Week 8 at Seattle per RotoWire) still out — then Johnson is the only back left. Carried from Friday's research (RotoWire TNF usage 22 Oct); this run found nothing newer.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The tool's weakest movable receiver is Rashee Rice (out again, 0.0) — but the risers are vacancy or volume roles and priority never resets; the one priority-worthy add, Loveland, is a tight end and is the Do-first card. Six weeks of data, still thin. Kupp and Shaheed printed but are not in the league file's wire.
